permits.description: to comply with nov: 201959111. change of use from mixed use b/r-3 to group housing(r-3). add interior stair and exit corridor. add class 2 bike parking(2 stalls).
comply with sffd nov dated 6/28/19, emergency lighting, c/o smoke detectors, fire extinguishers. restrict sleeing to 5 persons in bedroom nearest to street. maher n/a.
proposed foundation underpinning at the north property line of adjacent lightwell.
reroofing (tear off existing and replace new one. flat roof replace in kind, no change to sheathing.

add 1 hour separation wall at 1st floor & 1 hour shaft at basement exit stair to eliminate openings at stairway per district inspectors request. no exterior or other work. revision to pa# 200612119628.

revision to appl#200608078813 work includes (n) wall at basement and ground floor to seperate commercial from residential use above. drawings also show (e) as built conditions in commercial space plus other minor alterations. no lighting or mechanical changes required.
1 exist. bathroom renovation-new fixtures & finishes. no relocations, no structural change lighting to be flourescent on a motion detector.
demo at 2nd floor to remove exterior deck and rear doors and exterior siding in advance of renovation under pa# 200608078813.

remove (e) 2nd floor deck and construct horizontal addition to rear property line (approved variance 2006.0096v for this work). install new roof deck above new extension w/ new stair to rear property line. facade alteration under separate permit.
